why_realistic: lib.CONFIG_FALLBACKS spells the XDG companion repo '~/.config/daily-hotspots-config', and step 5 of this module's docstring exists only so the resolver is a strict superset of that probe. Dropping the -config suffix reads like tidying a redundant word under ~/.config and makes the lane unreachable: the directory the fleet actually creates is never looked at, so a configured machine answers 'uninitialized', which is the answer that made three real private repos invisible to the boundary tooling while the report stayed green.
oracle:
"""The XDG lane has to look for the directory name the rest of the fleet writes.

lib.CONFIG_FALLBACKS lists '~/.config/<skill>-config' and datadir's docstring names that same
spelling as discovery step 5, present so that rewiring a writer from the per-skill probe to this
resolver cannot turn a working machine into a hard failure. A resolver that probes a different name
never finds the companion repo, returns None, and every caller correctly reports the skill as having
no data at all.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path

import datadir

SKILL = "daily-hotspots"


def _isolate(monkeypatch, home):
    for var in ("DAILY_HOTSPOTS_DATA_DIR", "DAILY_HOTSPOTS_CONFIG", "DAILY_HOTSPOTS_CONFIG_DIR"):
        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)
    for var in ("HOME", "USERPROFILE"):
        monkeypatch.setenv(var, str(home))
    for var in ("HOMEDRIVE", "HOMEPATH"):
        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)
    # The sibling convention would otherwise answer first and this test would pass without ever
    # exercising the XDG lane.
    monkeypatch.setattr(datadir, "_convention_roots", lambda skill: [])
    assert Path(os.path.expanduser("~")) == home, "the harness failed to move $HOME; test is inert"


def test_the_xdg_companion_repo_is_discovered(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    home = tmp_path / "home"
    companion = home / ".config" / ("%s-config" % SKILL)
    companion.mkdir(parents=True)
    _isolate(monkeypatch, home)

    got = datadir.resolve_data_dir(SKILL)
    assert got is not None, (
        "a machine with %s present resolved to None, so a configured install reads as "
        "uninitialized" % companion)
    assert Path(got) == companion, "resolved %s, expected %s" % (got, companion)


def test_the_xdg_data_subdir_wins_when_present(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    home = tmp_path / "home2"
    companion = home / ".config" / ("%s-config" % SKILL)
    (companion / "data").mkdir(parents=True)
    _isolate(monkeypatch, home)
    assert Path(datadir.resolve_data_dir(SKILL)) == companion / "data"


def test_an_empty_home_is_still_uninitialized(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Negative control: the lane answers None when nothing is there, so it is not always-on."""
    home = tmp_path / "home3"
    home.mkdir(parents=True)
    _isolate(monkeypatch, home)
    assert datadir.resolve_data_dir(SKILL) is None
